description:
This protocol automates the mastermix distribution portion of the Lyra Direct SARS-CoV-2 Assay.
Using an Opentrons P20 Single-Channel Pipette, this protocol will transfer 15µL of mastermix from a 1.5mL eppendorf tube to the specified number of wells in a standard 96-well PCR plate.


If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at protocols@opentrons.com.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.21.0 or later)
Opentrons Temperature Module, GEN2
96-Well Aluminum Block for Temperature Module
Opentrons P20 Single-Channel Pipette
Opentrons 20µL Filter Tip Rack
Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack Set
NEST 96-Well PCR Plate
Eppendorf 1.5mL Microcentrifuge Tube
Lyra Direct SARS-CoV-2 Assay Kit



Deck Layout

Slot 2: Opentrons 20µL Filter Tip Rack

Slot 3: Opentrons Temperature Module with 96-Well Aluminum Block and NEST 96-Well PCR Plate

Slot 6: Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack Set with 24-Tube Topper, containing eppendorf 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube containing mastermix in position D1

Opentrons 96 Well Aluminum Block with NEST Well Plate 100 µL on Temperature Module GEN2 on 3
